Domains include chip design, cybersecurity, and RSI.
Benchmark aims to standardize measurement of AI agents for industry and research.

windows_malware_ai.headline: AI‑Powered VOLTA‑AUTODOXER Malware Profiles Victims for Ransomware
windows_malware_ai.summary: New malware steals credentials and crypto wallets, then uses AI models like Claude, Kimi K2, and Gemini 2.5 Flash to rank victim value.
highlights: VOLTA‑AUTODOXER exfiltrates passwords, tokens, seed phrases, and screenshots before AI assessment.
AI dossier generated via OpenRouter, defaulting to Claude, with fallbacks to Kimi K2 and Gemini 2.5 Flash.
Malware self‑deletes after posting ranked target assessments to a Telegram channel, leaving a debug file.

supermarket_freezers_cyberattack_europe.headline: European Supermarket Freezers Hit by “Cold War” Cyberattack
supermarket_freezers_cyberattack_europe.summary: Hackers remotely turned freezers in Ireland, Sweden, Belgium, Luxembourg and Estonia into heaters, spoiling food and echoing the October French incident.
highlights: Over 400 French supermarkets suffered losses in October 2026 when freezers heated to 120°F (50°C).
Targets now include **Supervalu**, **Axfood**, and **ICA** stores across five European nations.
The attacks exploit weak authentication in older IoT refrigeration management systems.
The US military is investigating similar refrigeration breaches at six domestic bases.

llmjacking_report.headline: Google reports LLMjacking attacks racking up $100K‑plus daily cloud bills
llmjacking_report.summary: Attackers hijacking enterprise LLM access are generating fraudulent cloud charges exceeding $100,000 per day, with some victims facing near‑million‑dollar bills before detection.
highlights: UNC6993 exploited mis‑configured service‑account keys to access LLM APIs
CVE‑2026‑40217 in LiteLLM allowed attackers to turn virtual keys into admin credentials
Jet Night token‑routing service sold stolen LLM access for $60‑monthly plans
Victims incurred up to $1 million in charges before access was revoked

anthropic_compute_deal_spree.headline: Marvell to Acquire Lumentum in $115 B All‑Stock Deal, Targeting AI Data‑Center Market
anthropic_compute_deal_spree.summary: Marvell Technology announced a $115 billion all‑stock acquisition of optical components maker Lumentum, aiming to strengthen its AI connectivity portfolio.
highlights: Deal valued at $115 billion, including debt, creating one of the largest tech mergers of 2026
Lumentum’s optical components will bolster Marvell’s data‑center and AI chip offerings
Both companies received $2 billion investments from Nvidia earlier this year

applebees_security_issue.headline: Applebee’s Mobile App Flaw Exposed Customer Data via Hardcoded Credentials
applebees_security_issue.summary: A hardcoded database credential in Applebee’s Android app leaked names, emails, birthdays and other personal details, prompting a rapid fix by Dine Brands.
highlights: Researchers from What Security used AI to discover hardcoded credentials in the app’s source code.
Exposed data included names, emails, birth dates, phone numbers, ZIP codes and IP addresses.
The app has over one million Google Play downloads, increasing exposure risk.
Dine Brands patched the flaw and reported no evidence of unauthorized access.

malware_racket.headline: Google Bans MECOOL After Malware Botnet Hijacks 1.3 Million Android TV Boxes
malware_racket.summary: Google cut ties with Videostrong’s MECOOL Android TV boxes after uncovering a backdoor that turned 1.3 million devices into a malware‑driven botnet.
highlights: The XCPE backdoor enabled ad‑fraud, residential proxy enrollment, and data exfiltration.
Videostrong sold access to the compromised boxes to criminal affiliates.
Google revised its device review program to close the security testing gap.
Infected devices also included Android‑based IoT products such as karaoke machines and digital signage.

marvell_acquires_lumentum.headline: Marvell to Acquire Lumentum in $115 B All‑Stock AI Connectivity Deal
marvell_acquires_lumentum.summary: Marvell will buy Lumentum for an implied $115 billion, exchanging each Lumentum share for 4.5 Marvell shares, creating a combined AI connectivity powerhouse.
highlights: Lumentum valued at $1,132 per share, a 23.9% premium
Marvell shareholders will own ~67% and Lumentum shareholders ~33% of the combined company
Combined addressable market projected at $550 billion with over $1 billion in annual run‑rate synergies
Deal expected to close in H1 2028 pending stockholder and regulatory approvals
Matt Murphy remains CEO, and three Lumentum directors join Marvell’s board

crypto_exchange_breach_brazil.headline: Mercado Bitcoin Halts Withdrawals After $46M Breach, Tether Freezes $4.5M USDT
crypto_exchange_breach_brazil.summary: Brazil's leading crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin stopped all withdrawals following a security breach that exposed over $46 million in user assets, prompting Tether to freeze more than $4.5 million USDT.
highlights: The breach was identified by blockchain analytics firm Arkham, which reported the loss of $46 million plus in assets.
Tether responded by freezing 4.5 million USDT linked to the compromised wallets.
Mercado Bitcoin has suspended both crypto and fiat withdrawals while investigators assess the incident.

rsi_warning.headline: Anthropic Signals Imminent Leap Toward Recursive Self‑Improvement AI
rsi_warning.summary: Anthropic’s latest S‑1/A filing warns it may soon achieve recursive self‑improvement, a capability that could dramatically accelerate AI development while raising safety concerns.
highlights: Anthropic’s filing cites recent use of AI to create models whose capability jumps were not initially recognized
The company’s Responsible Scaling Policy now flags potential "dramatically accelerated progress" from AI‑assisted R&D
Anthropic asserts no model has yet crossed the RSI threshold and vows to keep humans in the loop
Claude’s coding, math, and cybersecurity abilities have surged, prompting heightened scrutiny

flashprove_release.headline: Anthropic Unveils FlashProve for Zero‑Knowledge AI Inference Proofs
flashprove_release.summary: Anthropic released FlashProve, an open‑source prototype that generates zkSNARK proofs confirming Llama 4 Maverick responses came from committed weights without revealing them.
highlights: Proof generation reaches 110 tokens per second for Meta’s Llama 4 Maverick
Zero‑knowledge proof verification runs on a CPU in about 17 seconds per request
Prover fits on a single 80 GB GPU with 290 GB host memory
Open‑source repository includes C++ and Lean verifiers under the Apache 2.0 license

ascend960dt_hbm_supply.headline: Huawei's Ascend 960DT AI Chip to Leverage Samsung and SK Hynix HBM
ascend960dt_hbm_supply.summary: Huawei told select clients that the upcoming flagship AI processor Ascend 960DT will primarily use high‑bandwidth memory supplied by Samsung and SK Hynix.
highlights: The Ascend 960DT is positioned as Huawei's next‑generation flagship AI accelerator.
Samsung and SK Hynix will provide the majority of the HBM modules for the chip.
Huawei disclosed the memory sourcing to a limited group of enterprise customers.
The move highlights Huawei's continued reliance on external memory suppliers amid trade restrictions.

chatgpt_search_volume.headline: ChatGPT Captures Roughly 20% of Google Search Volume, OpenAI Claims
chatgpt_search_volume.summary: OpenAI says ChatGPT now handles about one‑fifth of the queries that Google Search processes, marking a significant shift in AI‑driven search competition.
highlights: ChatGPT’s search usage is estimated at **20%** of **Google Search** volume
OpenAI’s Adam Fry highlighted rapid growth since the AI‑search push two years ago
Google acknowledges lower monetization as AI features expand in its search product
Ads in ChatGPT are reportedly well‑received by users

gpt_6_astra_hardware_design.headline: OpenAI Claims GPT-6 Astra Designed Hardware Device in Under a Week
gpt_6_astra_hardware_design.summary: OpenAI reports its GPT-6 Astra model created a complete hardware device, from enclosure to firmware, in less than a week, with prototypes built in a month.
highlights: GPT-6 Astra handled enclosure design, PCB layout, component selection, trace routing, firmware, and UI autonomously
BenchCAD 2.0 benchmark shows the internal model scoring 0.875 while GPT-6 Astra reaches 0.594
Prototype batch produced by a contract manufacturer within a month despite several revision rounds
Token usage by OpenAI’s hardware teams for Codex and ChatGPT grew 23× since February

salesforce_cresta_acquisition.headline: Salesforce to Acquire Cresta for Reported $2.7 B, Expanding AI Service Suite
salesforce_cresta_acquisition.summary: Salesforce announced a $2.7 billion purchase of Cresta, adding AI‑driven customer service automation tools like Deputy and Opera to its Service Cloud.
highlights: Cresta’s platform uses AI to answer inquiries and schedule appointments
The deal follows Salesforce’s $3.6 billion acquisition of Fin Inc. earlier this year
Salesforce also agreed to buy Braze Inc. for $5.66 billion in AI marketing
Both Cresta and Braze deals are slated to close in the 2028 fiscal year

falcon_guardian_ai_kill_switch.headline: CrowdStrike Unveils AI Kill Switch in Falcon Guardian, Teams Up with Claude Cowork
falcon_guardian_ai_kill_switch.summary: CrowdStrike introduced a kill‑switch feature in its Falcon Guardian platform to halt rogue internal AI agents and announced integration with Anthropic’s Claude Cowork for enhanced threat response.
highlights: Falcon Guardian now includes an AI kill‑switch that can instantly disable misbehaving internal agents
The kill‑switch is designed to prevent autonomous AI actions that could compromise security
CrowdStrike partnered with Anthropic to embed Claude Cowork into Falcon Guardian for advanced analysis

siri_ai_integration_ios27_3.headline: Apple Enables Siri AI to Operate Across All Third‑Party Apps
siri_ai_integration_ios27_3.summary: Apple’s iOS 27.3 update lets Siri AI access any third‑party app, using personal context and on‑screen awareness to fulfill natural‑language requests.
highlights: Siri AI can execute tasks in third‑party apps without users naming the app
New “app skills” let developers combine multiple actions into a single voice command
Integration rolls out with iOS 27.3 and is available in Apple’s own apps like Calendar, Mail, and Maps
Users can query Siri AI about capabilities within each app, such as finding past coffee visits or archiving old files

whatsapp_ai_chats_android.headline: WhatsApp Adds Dedicated Meta AI Chats to Android Beta Update
whatsapp_ai_chats_android.summary: WhatsApp’s Android beta now lets users create separate Meta AI‑powered chats, complete with custom names and profile pictures, improving organization.
highlights: Separate Meta AI conversations appear as full chats in the chat list
Users can assign custom names and profile pictures to each AI chat
A new AI filter lets users quickly locate all Meta AI chats
Feature is rolling out to select Android beta testers via Google Play Store

oracle_scraps_ai_chip_lease_tencent.headline: Oracle aborts $7 B AI‑chip lease to Tencent after Trump‑admin pressure
oracle_scraps_ai_chip_lease_tencent.summary: Oracle cancelled a five‑year, roughly $7 billion agreement to lease about 100,000 advanced AI chips to Tencent following pressure from the Trump administration.
highlights: The deal was valued at approximately $7 billion over five years
It would have supplied Tencent with roughly 100,000 advanced AI chips
Pressure from the Trump administration forced Oracle to walk away
The cancellation underscores rising geopolitical scrutiny of AI hardware exports

amd_q3_earnings_ai_data_center.headline: AMD’s Data Center Surge Fueled by Agentic AI Beats Expectations
amd_q3_earnings_ai_data_center.summary: AMD reported a 45% revenue jump to $13.38 billion, driven by near‑doubling data‑center sales as agentic AI workloads boost CPU demand.
highlights: Data‑center revenue rose to 64% of total, up from 47% a year earlier.
AMD forecasts server revenue to double in fiscal 2027 as AI agents expand.
Major customers including Meta, Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Oracle are deploying AMD Helios rack systems.
AMD announced a $5 billion investment in Anthropic and a $1 billion equity stake in Meta’s Helion racks.

google_education_ai_policy.headline: Google threatens to block Search for schools that ban AI tools
google_education_ai_policy.summary: Google warned that schools restricting AI tools would lose Search access, sparking criticism from educators, politicians and antitrust officials over potential coercion.
highlights: Google announced new classroom AI products including Gemini, Gemini Notebook, and Gemini in Classroom
Access to Google Search will be disabled for K‑12 accounts unless schools explicitly enable AI tools
Mayor Zohran Mamdani, Sen. Bernie Sanders and FTC Chair Lina Khan condemned the policy as coercive

iphone_jailbreak_lockdown.headline: Calif Jailbreak Bypasses Apple Lockdown Mode and Survives iOS 27.2 Update
iphone_jailbreak_lockdown.summary: A hacker team demonstrated a jailbreak on an iPhone 18 Pro that works in Lockdown Mode and remains functional after upgrading to iOS 27.2.
highlights: Calif successfully jailbroke an iPhone 18 Pro while Lockdown Mode was active.
The jailbreak persisted after installing iOS 27.2.
The exploit was triggered via a malicious PDF delivered through AirDrop.
Apple claims Lockdown Mode provides “extreme protection” against mercenary spyware.
Calif says it will not release a public jailbreak tool.

flashprove_cryptographic_verification.headline: Anthropic unveils FlashProve to cryptographically verify AI model origins
flashprove_cryptographic_verification.summary: Anthropic's open‑source FlashProve uses zkSNARK proofs to confirm that a response came from a specific model without revealing its weights.
highlights: FlashProve generates proofs at roughly 110 tokens per second on a single H100 GPU for Meta's Llama 4 Maverick
Each proof is about 19 MB and can be verified in 17 seconds on a standard CPU
The system adds roughly 70×‑95× overhead compared with normal inference
FlashProve currently supports contexts up to 1,024 tokens and deterministic token selection only

ai_kill_switch_falcon_guardian.headline: CrowdStrike Unveils AI Kill Switch to Halt Rogue Enterprise Agents
ai_kill_switch_falcon_guardian.summary: CrowdStrike's new AI Kill Switch in Falcon Guardian lets human admins instantly terminate rogue AI agents, preventing damage and blocking relaunch across enterprise networks.
highlights: AI Kill Switch gives administrators direct control to terminate suspicious agent activity
Falcon Guardian monitors approved and shadow AI, detecting prompt injection attacks
Feature operates via Falcon sensor, stopping agents at gateway and endpoint

amdocs_eis_acquisition_2026_11_04.headline: Amdocs Buys EIS for $340 Million to Deploy Agentic AI in Insurance
amdocs_eis_acquisition_2026_11_04.summary: Amdocs has purchased insurance software firm EIS for $340 million, aiming to integrate its agentic AI platform aOS with EIS’s OneSuite for insurers.
highlights: Amdocs acquires EIS, adding policy administration, billing and claims systems to its portfolio
The deal includes $340 million cash with possible earn‑out payments tied to performance
EIS’s OneSuite is a cloud‑native, modular, API‑first platform with its own CoreGentic agentic tech
Amdocs plans to extend its aOS orchestration layer, originally built for telecom BSS/OSS, into insurance workflows

password_manager_breach_msecure.headline: mSecure breach forces users to reset passwords, MFA and passkeys
password_manager_breach_msecure.summary: mSecure’s encrypted cloud database was stolen, prompting the company to urge all users to change passwords, MFA methods and passkeys immediately.
highlights: Unauthorized actor obtained an encrypted copy of the mSecure cloud database containing current and former user data
Company advised rotating master passwords, stored credentials, two‑factor authentication and passkeys despite no evidence of
Criticism grew over sparse disclosures and the burden of resetting potentially hundreds of credentials
Similar incidents recently affected LastPass and Dashlane, highlighting broader password‑manager risks

copado_valoai_acquisition_2026_11_04.headline: Copado Acquires Valo.ai to Add Salesforce Security Observability
copado_valoai_acquisition_2026_11_04.summary: Copado’s purchase of Valo.ai brings real‑time security and operational observability to Salesforce environments, extending its governed delivery platform beyond release governance.
highlights: Copado integrates Valo.ai’s risk‑scoring engine to prioritize connected apps, dormant integrations, and excessive permissions.
Valo.ai provides a consolidated view of license spend, flagging inactive users and suggesting cost‑saving license changes.
The acquisition enables a phased roadmap where production intelligence feeds back into development and release workflows.
Valo.ai will remain a standalone product while Copado rolls out deeper integrated capabilities over time.

alabama_ai_data_center_campus.headline: Lambda Announces $33.1 B Alabama AI Data Center Campus
alabama_ai_data_center_campus.summary: Lambda plans to build the Red Clay Technology Center Campus in Lowndes County, a $33.1 billion AI data center powered by Alabama Power, slated to start in early 2027.
highlights: 1,000‑megawatt base power with expansion potential to 1,500 MW on a 2,200‑acre site.
Tax abatement offers 20‑year 50% reduction, projecting $2.85 billion county revenue through 2049.
Lambda commits $10 million community benefits and full funding for power infrastructure under the White House Ratepayer
Project will create over 1,000 construction jobs and 225 permanent technical positions.

openai_acquire_pierre_computer.headline: OpenAI to Acquire Pierre Computer, Boosting AI Agent Coding Tools
openai_acquire_pierre_computer.summary: OpenAI announced it will buy developer‑tool startup Pierre Computer, aiming to integrate its high‑performance code‑hosting service and open‑source libraries into Codex.
highlights: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer, a low‑profile developer tooling startup, with terms undisclosed
Pierre’s cloud service cut code‑retrieval latency by about 70% for AI startup Lovable Inc.
Pierre’s open‑source libraries Trees and Diffs power the interface of OpenAI’s Codex programming tool
OpenAI will keep Trees and Diffs open‑source and plans to embed Pierre’s paid storage into Codex

dreamhost_breach.headline: Hackers Exfiltrate Emails and Credentials from DreamHost in Prolonged Attack
dreamhost_breach.summary: DreamHost confirmed that hackers stole customer emails, credentials and session tokens after exploiting a file‑manager flaw, affecting well under 10% of its 400,000 users.
highlights: Attack began in August and remained undetected for months
Hackers obtained session tokens enabling full account takeover
Breach disclosed after multi‑day outage and password resets

chatgpt_gif_feature.headline: OpenAI Adds Native Animated GIF Creation to ChatGPT with Images 2.6
chatgpt_gif_feature.summary: OpenAI’s latest ChatGPT update, Images 2.6, lets users generate and edit animated GIFs directly, offering frame controls and two new API models for speed or quality.
highlights: ChatGPT can now turn prompts or uploaded photos into shareable animated GIFs
Users can adjust playback speed, edit individual frames, and preview each frame within the chat interface
Two new API models—GPT-Image-2.6 Flare for faster generation and GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst for higher‑quality output—are available
The rollout reaches all ChatGPT, Codex web, desktop and mobile users, expanding the existing Images 2.6 workflow

icloudcontentcheck.headline: Apple to Scan Public iCloud Links for Harmful Content in iOS 27.3
icloudcontentcheck.summary: Apple will begin scanning iCloud Photos and Drive links shared publicly for malware, CSAM and other harmful content starting with iOS 27.3 rollout.
highlights: Apple will access files shared via "Anyone with the link" for content checks
Content shared publicly is no longer end‑to‑end encrypted, even with Advanced Data Protection enabled
Violations may trigger account blocking, deletion or law‑enforcement involvement
The feature rolls out across iOS 27.3, iPadOS 27.3, macOS 27.3 and visionOS 27.3

metaacquiresconductor.headline: Meta Acquires Conductor to Boost Parallel AI Coding Agents
metaacquiresconductor.summary: Meta has bought Conductor, enabling developers to run multiple AI coding agents simultaneously, and will integrate the team into its Superintelligence Labs.
highlights: Conductor lets developers run several AI coding agents in parallel
CEO Charlie Holtz confirmed the team will join Meta Superintelligence Labs
The acquisition expands Meta’s portfolio of AI development tools

gpt_5_6_sol_revenue_inflection.headline: OpenAI Unveils Images 2.6 with GIF Creation as Revenue Inflection Gains Momentum
gpt_5_6_sol_revenue_inflection.summary: OpenAI introduced Images 2.6, delivering 50% faster image generation and animated GIF support, while President Greg Brockman cites agentic coding tools and GPT‑5.6 Sol driving a Q3 revenue inflection.
highlights: Images 2.6 generates images 50% faster than its predecessor
Adds animated GIF creation and frame‑level editing in ChatGPT
API adds two new models: Flare (six‑second generation) and Sunburst (higher‑quality consistency)
Brockman says agentic coding tools and GPT‑5.6 Sol sparked a revenue inflection in Q3

chrome_snapdragon_android_hack.headline: Hackers Exploit Chrome and Snapdragon GPU Flaws to Breach Android Phones
chrome_snapdragon_android_hack.summary: Researchers discovered a campaign that leveraged a Chrome bug and a Qualcomm Adreno driver flaw to silently steal cookies, logins and Wi‑Fi passwords from Android devices.
highlights: Chrome versions 139‑145 were vulnerable to CVE‑2026‑3910 code execution
Qualcomm Adreno driver flaw CVE‑2025‑27038 allowed sandbox escape
Malware named AndroSnitch harvested browser cookies, saved logins and Wi‑Fi passwords
Attack skipped Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra devices

images_2_6_release.headline: OpenAI Unveils Images 2.6 with GIF Creation and Faster Generation
images_2_6_release.summary: OpenAI's Images 2.6 rollout speeds image generation by 50%, adds GIF support, and introduces Flare and Sunburst models for developers via the API.
highlights: Images 2.6 generates images 50% faster and handles 4 billion images per week globally
New GIF feature lets users animate characters, sketches, and product shots in short loops
Flare can produce professional layouts in as little as six seconds at low quality
Sunburst focuses on high‑detail output and consistent edits for medium‑high quality
API now includes image markup, SVG export, and a complexity parameter for planning

ios_android_flaws_exploit.headline: Kremlin-linked Hackers Exploit Patched iOS and Android Flaws to Target Visitors
ios_android_flaws_exploit.summary: Hackers tied to Russia’s Foreign Intelligence Service used previously patched iOS and Android vulnerabilities to inject malicious JavaScript, stealing cookies, Wi‑Fi passwords, and device data.
highlights: The intrusion set leveraged a spoofed america250.holiday domain to proxy the legitimate america250.org site
Malicious JavaScript profiled devices and delivered platform‑specific payloads
Payloads attempted to exfiltrate browser cookies, Wi‑Fi passwords, and full mobile device data
Researchers linked the campaign to the Kremlin with moderate to high confidence

openai_linux_vuln_pipeline.headline: OpenAI’s Cyber Model Patches 948 Linux Kernel Flaws for $1.2 Million
openai_linux_vuln_pipeline.summary: OpenAI built an autonomous pipeline that identified, exploited and patched 948 local privilege escalation bugs in the Linux kernel at a total cost of $1.2 million.
highlights: The pipeline used an upcoming cyber model to automatically discover and validate each vulnerability.
All 948 flaws were patched, averaging about $1,000 per vulnerability in API costs.
The approach demonstrates a scalable method for hardening open‑source software like the Linux kernel.
OpenAI disclosed the effort publicly, highlighting potential for AI‑driven security research.

linux_privilege_escalation_pipeline.headline: OpenAI Pipeline Uncovers 948 Linux Kernel Privilege Escalation Flaws
linux_privilege_escalation_pipeline.summary: OpenAI’s new cyber model pipeline identified 948 unique local privilege escalation bugs in the Linux kernel, automatically generating candidate patches for review.
highlights: The run scanned 5,034 audit targets covering ~2.8 million kernel lines, about 7% of the codebase.
Researchers validated 1,724 vulnerabilities and produced 1,169 working local privilege escalation exploits.
OpenAI generated 948 distinct patches, though none have been merged yet.
The effort cost $1.213 million in API credits, roughly $1,279 per unique LPE.
The Daybreak initiative with Trail of Bits ensures human review before disclosure.
